text:
maria: Heads up — EU1 latency spike after the tokenizer shard flip. Ops estimates 10m of elevated tail. Proposing an out-of-band hotfix to pin the model and skip canary so we can restore tail latency quickly. @lina @kai pls +1 or veto.

kai: looking at traces, KV cache misses spiked at 12:03 UTC. Agree a short pin makes sense if smoke is fast. Need rollback criteria.

josh: Ops can provide a 15min change window. We can throttle traffic if something odd shows up. +1 from infra ops perspective.

lina: I'm +1 on pinning but we must keep canary toggles available. If smoke fails, immediate rollback to previous model and re-enable canary.

maria: rollback criteria: 1) p99 latency > 600ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR 2) error rate > 0.5% for 2 minutes. If either, rollback. Anyone object?

oliver: no objections. Please include the specific commit hash in the deploy command so SRE can track.

maria: deploy command I intend to run:```redwood deploy --env eu1 --model rwd-tokenizer@c3a9f1b --skip-canary --reason "hotfix: tail-latency" --notify ops,sre```

devops-bot: Deploy checklist: approvals required: infra, eng-sre, release. Current approvals: josh (infra), kai (eng-sre) pending, lina (infra) confirmed. Waiting on maria final ack.

kai: running quick smoke now against canary routing (10%):
- P95 180ms
- P99 420ms
- Errors 0.02%
Smoke looks good after initial burn.

maria: thanks. I'm giving final ack to proceed. Executing in ~2m. Tagging incident channel after done. @release-bot please add release note stub.

release-bot: Created release note draft: "hotfix: pin rwd-tokenizer@c3a9f1b to mitigate EU1 tail latency spike. Skipped canary to reduce time to restore. Rollback criteria defined." Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/2425001234

devops-bot: Deploy started: rolling to eu1, stage=0 -> 20% (15 pods). Monitoring: p99, errors, CPU, KV-miss. ETA to 100% ~ 4m.

kai: observing metrics during rollout: p99 dropping to 230ms at 20%, CPU stable, KV-miss rate down. No error signals.

maria: continuing to 100%.

devops-bot: Deploy update: 50% -> 100% complete. All checks green.

josh: verifying infra logs for any unusual reconnects — none.

lina: post-deploy smoke passed. I'll hold traffic window open for 10m then close.

maria: closing change window in 8m unless rollback criteria trigger. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:

release-bot: Release finalized and tagged. Notes: actioned pin, skip-canary, rollback criteria included, rollback instructions saved in runbook.

maria: follow-up: schedule a postmortem to investigate why tokenizer shard flip spiked KV misses. Assigning to @kai and @oliver.

oliver: ack — will collect traces and prepare short blameless summary.
